note: The `architecture` fixture (filament-core-data#173), the bundle QSL intake tests read. It is modelled on QSpec TC-197 fixture Y so its declaration keys line up with the QSpec vectors: value type Count; object types Sys, Pump (with operation run) and Tank as spec-objects-business entities, each with an identity field (entity requires one); interfaces Flow (field rate: Count 1..1, declared in `## Properties` per quire-rs FR-070 -- this is a generic, manifest-independent extraction, not a body_extraction locator) and Flow2 (specializes Flow, adds operation reset); parts sys_pump and sys_tank owned by Sys; ports pump_out (out) and tank_in (in) typed by Flow; connection pipe pump_out -> tank_in source-to-target; allocation pump_alloc of Pump/run to sys_pump. Every artifact id is its declaration key, word-style with underscores. Lifted under spec-objects-business, edge-vocabulary and spec-objects-architecture, the last pinned to SOA 376612e (merged, unreleased; latest tag v0.6.0 is behind); passes when an SOA release containing 376612e is pinned -- release decision: Peter (see modules/spec-objects-architecture/PROVENANCE.json). Divergences from Y forced by the pinned modules: Count is a value_object with one field `value` (min 0, max 9) because business 0.4.0 has no scalar value type. Not yet authored: population Q and the navigation relationships Sys/composition and Pump/housing (their end roles and multiplicities need the 0.5.0 `## Relationships` tables). No goldens yet: blocked on two confirmed upstream gaps -- quire-rs#461 (CellRole::kinds() narrows Part.owner to kind `part` and Allocation's operation-bearing source element to kind `interface`, contra QSpec FR-152 and TC-197 itself; fix in progress) and a distinct filament-core-data gap, constructs.rs::unlowered_model_feature (crates/extraction-frontend/src/constructs.rs:503-507) hardcoding `part`, `port`, `connection`, `allocation` and `featureOrder` (the `## Features` table) as never-lowered regardless of what the construct declares -- no lowering code for any FR-152 systems-model member exists anywhere in this crate yet (grep for `declaredType`/`sourceElement`/`targetElement`/`flowDirection`/`interfaceType` in src/ returns nothing).
